name: Goblin Boss

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: As a bonus action, the goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The goblin makes two attacks, using Scimitar or Shortbow in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage. If the attack roll had advantage, add another 2 (1d4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage. If the attack roll had advantage, add another 2 (1d4) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Redirect Attack
reactions.description: When a creature the goblin can see hits it with an attack roll, the goblin swaps places with a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of it that isn't incapacitated, and that ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

description: Goblin bosses lead their warband's raiding parties, staying just behind the front line while directing the battle and rewarding the boldest of their underlings.
